subject: general
question: In 2022, the Centre constituted a committee headed by former Union Agriculture Secretary _______ to look into the issues of minimum support price (MSP).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Agrawal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2022, the Centre constituted a committee headed by former Union Agriculture Secretary **Sanjay Agrawal** to look into the issues of **minimum support price **(MSP).
 
• The committee was formed to address various concerns related to the MSP system, which is a crucial aspect of Indian agricultural policy.
 
• The MSP system ensures that farmers receive a minimum price for their produce, protecting them from price fluctuations in the market.
 
• Sanjay Agrawal's leadership in the committee is expected to bring in-depth expertise and experience in agricultural policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The formation of the committee followed widespread protests by farmers demanding better MSP and other reforms in the agricultural sector.
 
• The committee's recommendations are expected to play a significant role in shaping future agricultural policies in India.
 
• The MSP is announced by the Government of India at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops based on the recommendations of the **Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)**.
 
• The aim of MSP is to **ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce**, thereby safeguarding the interests of the farmers.
